entities.summary: Stefano Ticozzi was an Italian politician, scholar and art historian. He is best known for his two-volume Dizionario degli architetti, scultori, pittori, an up-to-date assembly of biographical data and works of artists from Europe of the prior four centuries to the contemporary time.
